the file fuses four distinct concerns: per-ticket store walk, tracker-level health checks, JSON report shaping, and CLI driver; each new check grows the fused whole monotonically
_tracker_health and its four helper functions already have a single call site from _scan, representing a natural module boundary that was cut but not followed through to extraction
the refactoring decomposes _scan and _check_snapshot further to stay under the C901 complexity threshold, retiring 43 points of recorded debt from complexity-baseline.json instead of relocating it
external callers across the codebase (gitutil.py, fsck_recover.py, tracker_maintenance.py, tests) depend on six fsck.<symbol> attributes that must remain accessible as module-level re-exports
behavior must be preserved identically: all findings, text output, JSON output, exit codes, and counted/informational classifications remain unchanged
